title: Vault Dweller and Power Armor
description: A young woman in a blue Vault jumpsuit stands on a metal railing holding a futuristic device, looking up with a concerned expression. Behind her a massive green power armor suit aims a pistol while a small robot stands beside it, all within a ruined industrial shaft filled with glowing green radiation and towering cranes under a purple sky.
prompt: A dramatic low angle view inside a massive decaying industrial reactor shaft with broken concrete walls and glowing green radioactive slime. In the foreground a young woman in a blue and yellow Vault 111 jumpsuit stands on a rusty railing holding a Pip-Boy, looking upward with concern. Behind her stands a large green T-60 power armor suit firing a pistol with muzzle flash and smoke, accompanied by a small floating robot. Giant construction cranes loom above against a toxic purple and yellow sky, with red warning banners and flickering lights, cinematic lighting, detailed environment
